issue: K-line and model differences were hard to read; old static dashboard defaulted to stale paper_trading rows while latest actor signals were only visible as metadata.
changes: Dashboard V2 keeps SOXLBacktest as the default action comparison baseline.
Dashboard V2 latest model signal board is explicitly labelled and shows actor latest signals against the baseline.
Dashboard V2 K-line height and model-difference table height were increased for readability.
Dashboard V2 main K-line no longer overlays historical model-difference markers; historical differences remain in the difference table and position/NAV panes.
Dashboard V2 manifest marks latest actor signals as comparison_included when signals are available.
Static dashboard latest_version now prefers the newest data window when paper_trading rows lag its latest signal.
Static export checker allows a non-paper latest_version only when paper_trading rows lag the latest signal.
verification: PYTHONPATH=. qlib_venv/bin/python -m pytest tests/test_dashboard.py tests/test_dashboard_v2_data.py tests/test_dashboard_v2_checker.py tests/test_vercel_dashboard.py -q
